To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a family of information measures can be constructed based upon the minimum number of pixel value changes required to convert an image into one having a specified histogram and that this family of information measures is useful for similarity retrieval in pictoral information systems.

a family of picture information measure is defined, and a natural extension of the picture information measures to the Lorenz information measure and to the structural information measure is presented.

the family of picture information measure based upon the minimum number of grey level changes to convert the histogram of a picture to a desired histogram is found to satisfy many useful axioms and inequalities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a family of picture information measure which can be used in a similarity retrieval system.
a study of the information theoretic properties of the picture information measures.
a family of information measures for pictures.

the proposed information measures have the potential for use in the development of a similarity retrieval system for pictures.
picture information measures can be defined and used for the purposes of similarity retrieval.
picture information measures are a very important concept in information retrieval.

a picture is a set of picture elements, and a set is an information source.

we have developed a family of picture information measure based on the concept of minimum number of gray-level changes.

the picture information measures are a useful and practical tool for similarity retrieval.
